recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. If archived STU3/DSTU2-era published pages still expose old W3C or GitHub Pages comparison URLs, handle that as archival site maintenance outside the current FHIR source build.
issue_request: FHIR-12664 reported that a W3C Compare to DSTU2 link for valueset.html returned 404 because the generated doc2 URL pointed at http://hl7-fhir.github.io//valueset.html.
initial_application: Commit 30134feeb7378c3eecbd128ee882a6789b7bcde8, '#12664 - fix build problem,' matches the Jira comment citing SVN revision 11841. It changed the then-current footer and added a PageProcessor baseURL workaround to map the obsolete hl7-fhir.github.io build URL to http://build.fhir.org.
additional_context: The current build no longer uses the historical source/newfooter.html or Java PageProcessor path. The active shared footer is tools/templates/newfooter.html, which is included by current generated pages and now uses FHIR-hosted htmldiff.pl links for R4, R5, and the last ballot. Existing reconciliation commits for FHIR-17217, FHIR-13802, and FHIR-46684 document later cleanup of the same compare-link family.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source contains no Compare to DSTU2 W3C doc1/doc2 link and no active compare link targeting hl7-fhir.github.io//valueset.html; the current rendered valueset.html compare links use build.fhir.org as the newfile host.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue about malformed Compare to DSTU2 footer links; its existing audit commit confirms the current build no longer has the obsolete DSTU2/doc2 construction and cites FHIR-12664 as the earlier same-family build-link problem.

Later Published issue about build-page Compare links resolving new documents under http://hl7-fhir.github.io//; its existing audit commit confirms build.sh and the current footer now target build.fhir.org instead.

Later Applied issue about retiring stale W3C htmldiff references; its existing fix commit removed the remaining current-source W3C diff note after the shared footer moved to the FHIR-hosted comparison endpoint.
